description_en: Creates a smoke test workflow by calling the RunSmokeTest operation
description_zh: 调用RunSmokeTest接口创建冒烟测试工作流
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public run-smoke-test --project-env PROD --bizdate 2020-05-26_00:00:00 --name xm_create_test --node-id 1234 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunSmokeTest

parameters.help_en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values:

PROD: production environment.
DEV: development environment.

Workspaces in basic mode do not have a development environment. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85772.html
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间的环境，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）。
简单模式的工作空间无开发环境，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85772.html
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en:
The business date.

The format is `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. Example: `2020-05-26 00:00:00`
parameters.help_zh:
业务日期。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2020-05-26 00:00:00`
parameters.name: bizdate

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to obtain the node ID.

Full retrieval path: first call ListProjects to obtain the ProjectId, then call ListNodes, and obtain the node ID from Data.Nodes[].NodeId
parameters.help_zh:
节点的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口获取节点ID。

完整获取路径：先通过 ListProjects 获取 ProjectId，再调用 ListNodes，并从 Data.Nodes[].NodeId 获取
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The parameters of the node. This parameter is configured as a JSON string. The key is the node ID, and the value is the actual parameter value
parameters.help_zh: 节点的参数。配置为一个JSON字符串，Key为节点 ID，Value为参数实际取值
parameters.name: node_params

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
